kpis.description_fr: NIM consolidé FY24. Élevé grâce mix Mexique/Turquie/LatAm (taux hauts). #1 Mexique via Bancomer, leader Espagne.
kpis.description_en: Consolidated NIM FY24. High thanks to Mexico/Turkey/LatAm mix (high rates). #1 Mexico via Bancomer, Spain leader.

kpis.description_fr: CET1 fully loaded FY24. Solide vs exigence ~9.1%. Marge confortable pour M&A (offre Sabadell).
kpis.description_en: CET1 fully loaded FY24. Solid vs ~9.1% requirement. Comfortable room for M&A (Sabadell bid).

kpis.description_fr: Résultat net Mexique FY24 (€). Pilier groupe (>40% bénéfice). Bancomer leader incontesté Mexique. Banxico taux à 10%.
kpis.description_en: Mexico net attributable profit FY24 (€). Group pillar (>40% earnings). Bancomer undisputed Mexico leader. Banxico rate at 10%.

kpis.description_fr: RoTE FY24. Parmi les meilleurs banques EU. Combine pricing power EM + rigueur capital + buybacks.
kpis.description_en: RoTE FY24. Among best EU banks. Combines EM pricing power + capital discipline + buybacks.

kpis.description_fr: Ratio coût/revenu FY24. Best-in-class EU banks. Efficience digitale + scale. Cible <40% atteinte.
kpis.description_en: Cost-to-income ratio FY24. Best-in-class EU banks. Digital efficiency + scale. <40% target achieved.

kpis_story.description_fr: OPA hostile Sabadell lancée mai 2024 (€12-13Md valeur). Création #2 banque espagnole. Opposition gouvernement Sanchez. Décision CNMC + autorités prévue 2025. Synergies estimées €850M/an.
kpis_story.description_en: Hostile Sabadell bid launched May 2024 (€12-13Bn value). Creates #2 Spanish bank. Sanchez government opposition. CNMC + authorities decision expected 2025. €850M/year synergies estimated.

_notes: Spain's #2 bank (LatAm focus). Source: 20-F FY24 filed Feb 2025.
